family_context.support: Original author manuscript identifies diaqua-bis(5-nitroso-8-oxyquinolinato)zinc(II), composition C18H14N4O6Zn, and deposited structure 983710. Two deprotonated conjugated ligands and two water molecules support Zn(II). Input N-O is 1.235 A and phenolate C-O 1.295 A; complete independent graph matches including all 14 H. Resonance witness resolves the arbitrary-Kekule long-bond flags without modifying the native standard.
